description: Deterministic hashing on the server: SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 or SHA-1 over your text, or HMAC with the same digests when you pass a key. Returns the lowercase hex digest and the input byte length; the HMAC key is never echoed back. Same input always gives the same digest, so any third party can recompute and verify it. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base, no account, no API key). 【価格】0.00 USDC。【使い方】呼ぶと 402 と PAYMENT-REQUIRED（支払い条件）が返る。USDC で支払い、同じ引数に PAYMENT-SIGNATURE ヘッダを添えて再送すると結果が返る。

hmac_key.description: Optional HMAC key; when given, returns HMAC instead (the key is never echoed back)

name: crypto-hash
